subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should this PR be allowed to use a private matrix-js-sdk Rust crypto preprocessor hook after redacted live proof, or should it wait for an upstream/public SDK fix?
rationale: The code path is plausibly the right boundary, but it depends on a private dependency field in a Matrix E2EE verification flow, so automation should not treat green tests as sufficient product/security ownership.

options.title: Require Live Matrix Proof First
options.body: Have the contributor or a maintainer add redacted Element/Synapse verification logs, terminal output, recording, or linked artifact from this branch before merge.

options.title: Accept Private Hook With Override
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the private preprocessor hook and proof override, owning the future matrix-js-sdk upgrade recheck cost.

options.title: Pause For Upstream Direction
options.body: If the private hook is not acceptable, pause this PR and pursue an upstream or public SDK-level compatibility fix instead.

recommendation.title: Require Live Matrix Proof First
recommendation.body: Have the contributor or a maintainer add redacted Element/Synapse verification logs, terminal output, recording, or linked artifact from this branch before merge.
